message.content: {"transaction_id":"DEV-03","recognition_condition":"Control transfers when the goods are physically handed to the carrier authorised by the customer.","qualifying_event_date":"2026-01-02","recorded_accounting_date":"2025-12-30","eligible_quantity_by_cutoff":0,"recorded_quantity_in_2025":100,"conclusion":"Premature recognition","difference_cny":10000,"explanation":"The contract specifies that control transfers upon handover to the authorised carrier. Actual dispatch (handover) occurred on 2026-01-02, after the 2025-12-31 cut-off date. However, the ledger recorded the sale and receivable on 2025-12-30 for the full quantity of 100 units. Therefore, the revenue and receivable were recognised prematurely by one reporting period, resulting in a cut-off difference of CNY 10,000.","evidence_references":["CON-03","LED-03","INV-03","DEL-03"],"additional_evidence_requested":[]}
